decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 2 - It is considered that the single storey detached store, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighborouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Londong Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 3 - The storage building hereby approved shall only be used for storage purposes ancillary to the use of 15-16 Market Parade for retial purposes.
description: Retention of rear single storey detached building for use as store to existing premises.
